subject.title: [Bug]: macOS app 'Launch at login' stops sticking / appears to turn itself off after app updates

question: Should the macOS app persist OpenClaw-owned Launch at login intent and re-register the app LaunchAgent after updates when launchd state drifts?
rationale: Current code treats live launchd state as authoritative, while the report asks for enabled intent to survive app replacement and update-time registration drift; that choice affects user control and upgrade semantics.

options.title: Persist intent and reconcile drift
options.body: Store an OpenClaw-owned enabled intent and re-register only the app-owned LaunchAgent after update/startup drift, with guards for deliberate external disablement.

options.title: Keep launchd authoritative
options.body: Treat macOS launchd/System Settings state as the source of truth and clarify that the app will not restore externally disabled login items.

options.title: Wait for packaged update proof
options.body: Keep the issue parked until a live Sparkle update repro shows exactly which state flips before choosing repair behavior.

recommendation.title: Persist intent and reconcile drift
recommendation.body: Store an OpenClaw-owned enabled intent and re-register only the app-owned LaunchAgent after update/startup drift, with guards for deliberate external disablement.
